rows.grounds: ritual seat or pedestal as object of worship
qualifies the seat as the initial one
first member of compound with mantrataḥ
taddhita -tas indicating instrumental means; refers to the seat-mantra

items.question: What preparatory act and means govern worship of the first seat?
premises: Meditation must precede the act of worship.
The first seat is the designated object of worship.
Worship of the seat is performed by means of its mantra.
items.inference: After meditation, the practitioner should worship the first seat using the seat-mantra.
uncertainties: Whether pīṭhaṃ prathamaṃ refers to a specific named seat in this ritual sequence is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Having meditated, one should worship the first seat by means of the seat-mantra.
